Fetch from the remote of each project

Usage: slipway fetch [OPTIONS] [NAME... | project/NAME...]

Arguments:
  [NAME]...  The name of a project

Options:
  -l, --selector <EXPR>  Selector (label query) to filter on
  -A, --all-groups       Fetch every project across all groups
      --prune            Before fetching, remove any remote-tracking references that no longer exist
                         on the remote
      --dry-run          Print what would change and write nothing
  -h, --help             Print help (see more with '--help')

Use "slipway --help" for a list of global options (applies to all commands).
